ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: The assistant automatically generates draft replies for incoming messages, ready for your review. You can also chat with it in the side panel to search, organise and manage your inbox. The assistant never sends email automatically: messages are only ever sent when you click Send.
ai.off: Disabled. No data from this mailbox is processed by AI models.
ai.switchLabel: Enable AI assistant for this mailbox

facts.title: How it works
facts.text: When a message arrives, the assistant reviews the email thread context and saves a recommended response in Drafts. In the side panel, you can ask it to search your archive, mark threads as read, sort mail into folders or discard drafts.

facts.title: Where data is processed
facts.text: Handled entirely by Cloudflare Workers AI within your own Cloudflare environment. Email content never leaves your Cloudflare account and is never sent to the underlying model providers or third-party AI platforms.

facts.title: Cloudflare retention policy
facts.text: Cloudflare discards message payloads immediately once an inference request completes. Your email is never retained or used to train foundation models. Only aggregate compute and usage telemetry are logged.

facts.title: Mail App local storage
facts.text: Generated responses remain saved in Drafts until you choose to send or remove them. The side-panel conversation retains its most recent {keep} queries and is visible to all users assigned to this mailbox. You can clear this conversation history at any time, and disabling the assistant purges it permanently.

facts.title: Excluded content
facts.text: Spam, and any messages your inbox rules send to Spam or the Bin, are excluded from AI analysis.

ai.dataLink: Review Cloudflare's Workers AI privacy & compliance commitments ↗
ai.modelNote: Select the model used to compose your draft suggestions. All models execute directly via Cloudflare Workers AI inside your personal Cloudflare infrastructure.
ai.pricingNote: Cloudflare provides a recurring daily allowance of complimentary Workers AI neurons. Any usage beyond this threshold is billed directly to your own Cloudflare account.
ai.pricingLink: View Cloudflare Workers AI pricing documentation ↗

spam.title: Blocked senders & spam filtering
spam.intro: Messages from these addresses or domains are routed straight to Spam. Mail App also automatically inspects emails from unfamiliar senders for phishing risks, deceptive links and junk characteristics, detailing why flagged items were filtered. Marking a message as Not spam returns it to your inbox and marks that sender as trusted.
spam.none: Add specific email addresses or entire domains to divert their messages directly to Spam.
spam.invalid: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com, or a domain, such as example.com.
spam.failed: That didn't save. Please try again.

signature.title: Email signature
signature.intro: Appended automatically to new messages, replies and forwards. You can edit or remove the signature in the composer before sending.
signature.label: Your signature

templates.title: Email templates
templates.intro: Save frequently sent text, such as business directions, standard instructions or price lists, for quick reuse. Insert any saved template directly from the composer menu and adapt the copy before sending.
templates.name: Name
templates.namePlaceholder: For example: Directions to the office
templates.subject: Subject (optional)
templates.needName: Give the template a name and a message.
templates.tooMany: You can save up to {max} templates. Delete one to add another.
templates.failed: That didn't save. Please try again.

outOfOffice.title: Out-of-office autoreply
outOfOffice.intro: Sends an automatic response to incoming messages while you are away. Senders receive at most one automated reply every four days; newsletters, mailing lists and automated system alerts are excluded automatically.
outOfOffice.messagePlaceholder: Thanks for your email. I'm away until Monday 3 November and will reply when I'm back.
outOfOffice.datesHint: All scheduled times use your local time zone. Leave Start date blank to activate immediately, and leave End date blank to keep autoreplies active until switched off manually.
outOfOffice.needMessage: Write a reply message, or switch out of office off.
outOfOffice.endBeforeStart: The end has to be after the start.
outOfOffice.paidNote: Outbound autoreplies require Cloudflare's Workers Paid plan ($5/month) to send to any external recipient. On Cloudflare's free tier, automatic replies are delivered only to pre-verified destination addresses.
outOfOffice.stateEnded: Ended {end}. It won't send any more replies.

autoContacts.title: Contact suggestions
autoContacts.intro: Automatically add people you correspond with to your contacts and address auto-complete suggestions. Disable this setting if you prefer to only suggest contacts you have created manually.
autoContacts.switchLabel: Automatically save contacts from incoming and outgoing mail

photos.title: Contact profile photos
photos.intro: Display profile photos using Gravatar. To retrieve an image, your browser securely sends a one-way hashed (scrambled) version of the contact's email address to Gravatar's servers. This feature remains disabled until you enable it.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.intro: Mail App creates a comprehensive snapshot of this mailbox every night, preserving all folders, labels and attachments. Backups are stored in standard .mbox format directly within your Cloudflare R2 storage, allowing you to download local archives or import your correspondence into email clients such as Apple Mail or Thunderbird.
backup.keepHint: Each copy takes up about as much space as your mailbox. Cloudflare's storage is free up to 10 GB.
backup.none: No backups yet. The first one is made tonight, or press Back up now.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup from {when}? This can't be undone.
backup.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
backup.started: Backup started. You can leave this page; it carries on.
backup.importIntro: Restore a previous Mail App backup, or import historical messages from Google Takeout (Gmail), Apple Mail or Mozilla Thunderbird using standard .mbox files. Duplicate messages are automatically identified and skipped, making it safe to re-run imports at any time.
backup.importStay: Please keep this page open until it finishes.
backup.importFailed: {n} couldn't be read and were left out.
backup.importTooBig: {n} were too large to bring in (over 90 MB each).
backup.importError: Bringing in mail stopped part way: {error} Choose the file again to carry on; mail already added is skipped.
backup.importLeave: Mail is still being brought in. Leave anyway?

addresses.title: Your addresses & aliases
addresses.intro: Secondary addresses at your domain (such as hello@ or support@) that route directly into this inbox. By default, replies are automatically sent from whichever address received the original message, and you can pick your sending address whenever composing a new email. Configure individual display names and email signatures for each address below.
addresses.mainNote: Its name is in Account and its signature is in Writing.
addresses.name: Name people see
addresses.signaturePlaceholder: Leave empty to use your main signature
addresses.removeConfirm: Stop getting email at {address}? Emails that already arrived stay where they are.
addresses.failed: That didn't save. Please try again.
addresses.plusTip: Anything after a + arrives here too, so {example} works without setting it up. It's handy for seeing who shared your address.
addresses.catchAllIntro: A catch-all gets email sent to any other address at a domain, even ones you haven't set up, such as a misspelt name. Without one, that email is lost. Each domain can have one.
addresses.catchAllElsewhere: {mailbox} is the catch-all for {domain} at the moment. Switching this on moves it here.
addresses.catchAllSpam: Spammers often guess addresses, so this can bring in more spam.
addresses.setUpOn: To create additional aliases or adjust your domain catch-all routing, visit the {link}.
addresses.replyFromReceived: The address the email was sent to
addresses.replyFromNote: You can always switch the From address manually on any message or reply before sending.
addresses.isCatchAll: This mailbox is also the catch-all, so it gets email sent to any other address at {domains}.
addresses.maskedIntro: With masked email on, every other address at a domain is a masked address for this mailbox: a made-up address to give a website instead of your real one. Its user can Keep or Block each new one, switch any off, and see which website leaked one. A domain has either a catch-all or masked email, not both.
addresses.maskedElsewhere: {mailbox} gets masked email at {domain} at the moment. Switching this on moves it here.
addresses.maskedReplacesCatchAll: Switching this on turns off the catch-all for {domain}.
addresses.catchAllReplacesMasked: Switching this on turns off masked email at {domain}.

addressAdmin.title: Addresses for {mailbox}
addressAdmin.intro: Extra addresses, such as hello@ or support@, arrive in this mailbox and can be sent from. Its name and signature for each one are set in that mailbox's Settings.

masked.title: Masked email
masked.intro: Generate a unique, disposable email address for every website rather than sharing your primary address. Inbound mail is delivered straight to this inbox, and you can reply directly from the masked address. If a site sends spam, leaks your data or sells your address, simply disable that alias to reject all future messages.
masked.makeUp: You can also make one up as you sign up somewhere, such as {example}. The first email to it asks you to keep it or block it.
masked.notOn: Masked email is not yet enabled for this mailbox. An administrator can enable it for your domain under {link}.
masked.label: What's it for? (optional)
masked.labelHint: Type the website's address and Mail App warns you if email comes to it from anywhere else.
masked.made: Your new masked address is ready.
masked.none: You haven't got any masked addresses yet.
masked.waitingNote: Email arrived at this address for the first time. Keep it to carry on getting mail there, or block it to send future mail back.
masked.leakNote: Email came from {site}, not the website this address was for. It may have been shared, sold or leaked.
masked.keepNewNote: When this is off, the first email to an address you've made up asks you to keep it or block it.
masked.failed: That didn't save. Please try again.
masked.bannerWaiting: This is the first email to this address. Keep it to carry on getting mail there, or block it to send future mail back to the sender.
masked.bannerLeak: This came from {site}, but the address was for {sites}. It may have been shared, sold or leaked. Switch it off and mail to it is sent back.
masked.bannerKept: Kept. Mail to {address} will keep arriving.
masked.bannerBlocked: Blocked. Mail to {address} will be sent back.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in instantly using Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello or your mobile device rather than waiting for an email verification code.
passkeys.how: Select Passkey next time Cloudflare prompts you to authenticate. Email verification codes remain active as a fallback.

passkeys.full: You have the most passkeys allowed. Remove one you no longer use to add another.
